summary: Essential Properties Realty Trust, Inc. filed an 8-K to report the closing of an underwritten public offering of $400M aggregate principal amount of 5.375% Senior Notes due 2036 by its subsidiary Essential Properties, L.P., fully guaranteed by the registrant. The notes were issued under an indenture and sold at 97.469% of par, maturing July 15, 2036, with semi-annual interest payments starting January 15, 2027. The offering is a routine debt capital markets transaction, not a special situation. No target, activist, or strategic review involved. What to watch: ongoing compliance with unencumbered asset covenants.
